# Field boundaries for Poland

Poland field boundaries (2025, 2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Agencja Restrukturyzacji i Modernizacji Rolnictwa. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl/latest/pl.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2180; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop_group, hcat:name_en, hcat:code, geometry, support_schemes, metrics:area, crop:code, crop:name, hcat:name, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl/collection.json
